{{Infobox incomplete|FO76WL|refID, level, derived stats, actor/dialogue if any}} {{Infobox character |games =FO76, FO76WL |image =FO76 The Blood.png |race =[[Human]]/[[ghoul]] |gender =Male/Female |affiliation =[[Blood Eagles]] |role =Leader |location =[[Bloody Frank's]] |quests =[[Spilling Blood]] |level = |derived = |actor = |dialogue =[[The Blood/Dialogue]] |edid =COMP_Beckett_RQ05_Name |formid ={{ID|005a1c07}} |refid ={{ID|}} }} '''The Blood''' is one of the leaders of the [[Blood Eagles]] in [[Appalachia]], along with [[The Eye]] and [[Frankie Beckett|The Claw]]. ==Background== As one of the Blood Eagles' triumvirate of leaders, The Blood has the duty to add new recruits to the Blood Eagles by means of abducting potential recruitsThe [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"Do you know where I should go?"''
[[Beckett (Wastelanders)|Beckett]]: ''"Yeah, The Blood normally travels around Appalachia looking for "recruits" to kidnap, but I have an idea where you can look."''
([[Beckett (Wastelanders)/Dialogue#241|Beckett's dialogue]]) and bringing them to the [[Dagger's Den]], where they get forcefully addicted to chems.[[Beckett (Wastelanders)|Beckett]]: ''"The Cave is where the the Blood Eagles store their supply of Buffout, without it... well, it'd be harder to convert new members."''
([[Beckett (Wastelanders)/Dialogue#901|Beckett's dialogue]])[[The Saga of The Horn]] Having experienced The Blood's cruelty first hand,The [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"[Intelligence 8+] The heart might represent love. When did you and your brother start drifting apart?"''
[[Beckett (Wastelanders)|Beckett]]: ''"When The Blood told me that I would get to watch everyone I love slowly get shredded in front of my eyes. I imagined everything I could do to stop loving anyone. I gladly overdosed on the Buffout to burn it out of my heart."''
([[Beckett (Wastelanders)/Dialogue#1008|Beckett's dialogue]]) [[Beckett (Wastelanders)|Beckett]] refers to them as a true monster who is giving him nightmares.The [[Vault Dweller (Fallout 76)|Vault Dweller]]: ''"Just point the way. Consider the Blood dead already."''
[[Beckett (Wastelanders)|Beckett]]: ''"Thanks. It means a lot, it seriously does. The Blood is a true monster... one that still gives me nightmares today."''
([[Beckett (Wastelanders)/Dialogue#235|Beckett's dialogue]]) The Blood is found hanging out at [[Bloody Frank's]] in [[Berkeley Springs]], only during the [[Spilling Blood]] quest. ==Interactions with the player character== ===Interactions overview=== {{Interactions FO76 |essential = |temp companion = |perm companion = |perk = |wares = |caps = |max condition = |heal = |cure addiction = |cure radiation = |rent = |items modified = |quests started = |quests involved =* [[Spilling Blood]] }} ==Inventory== {{Inventory |apparel =Randomized apparel |weapon =Randomized weapon |otheritem = |ondeath =Randomized loot }} ==Notes== * The Blood's appearance is completely randomized. Apart from gender, there is also a rare chance they can spawn as a [[ghoul]]. * [[Frank the Butcher]] and [[Jessi the Hook]] may appear to guard The Blood, although they do not always appear. ==Appearances== The Blood appears only {{in|FO76WL}}. ==Gallery== FO76 The Blood ghoul.png|The Blood spawned as a ghoul FO76WL The Blood ghoul alt.png|Alternative appearance as a ghoul, with [[Jessi the Hook]] in the background Fallout magic Wasteland Raider.png|What appears to be The Blood, The Eye and The Claw (Frankie Beckett) on a ''[[Magic: The Gathering]]'' card ==References== {{References}} {{Navbox Wastelanders}} {{Navbox Blood Eagles}} [[Category:Wastelanders human characters]] [[Category:Wastelanders ghoul characters]] [[Category:Wastelanders raider characters]] [[Category:Blood Eagles characters]] [[ru:Кровь]]

Where we provide worry-free government through the power of automation!|The chipper automated welcoming system}} '''Watoga Municipal Center''' is a [[Fallout 76 locations|building]] in the [[Appalachia]]n city of [[Watoga]]. ==Background== Located in the second tallest building in Watoga, the municipal center was the heart of governance for the city.''[[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide]]'', p. 496: ''"'''WATOGA MUNICIPAL CENTER'''''
''On the corner of RobCo Boulevard and Innovation West Street is the second-tallest building in town, offering access to the local government offices. Not surprisingly, the place is condemned. Access the interior via the elevator in the once-plush lobby. Use the stairs to reach the upper offices surrounding the main foyer; then ascend to the executive level, with an office, a courtroom (avoid falling into the hole in the floor), and the locked senator's office (2).
Head to a door via the fallen ceiling in the courtroom to reach the upper offices interior. Here, there's an office full of wastebaskets; a large lobby; an elevator to the roof; and the mayor's office, where you can contact Maia{{sic}} (the computer) while you check the corpse of the dead mayor.
Access the roof via the executive office-level elevator. Here you find a Scorchbeast nest of dirt, scrap, and detritus (which you can climb for the ultimate selfie!), as well as a long drop to your death. Exploration into some extremely "open-plan" maintenance offices is possible only from here."''
([[Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia#WATOGA MUNICIPAL CENTER|Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide Atlas of Appalachia]]) The establishment housed the civic offices and courtrooms utilized for the oversight and management of the city, as well as the mayor's office. ==Layout== The municipal center is located at the corner of RobCo Boulevard and Innovation West in the southeastern part of Watoga. The lobby offers shelter from the robots roaming the city, with the still-functioning elevator leading to the derelict interior. The main foyer is the central focal point, surrounded by three floors. On the ground floor are restrooms in the southwestern part with the information office to the east and terminals against the wall. The stairs in the northeast lead to the upper floor. The second floor contains the complaints archive on the western face, complete with a locked [[Safe (Fallout 76)|safe]] and a [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazine]] spawn point behind the desk, near the terminal. The corridor that leads into the office part of the complaints archive also loads to another office in the south, which contains a second potential magazine spawn point. There is the locked executive office in the northeast, which contains a locked safe that can be opened with the terminal and a potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobblehead]] spawn. The stairs in the southeast, near the broken elevator, lead to the third floor. It contains the judge's office with a potential Vault-Tec bobblehead spawn point and a safe, with a courtroom in the northwestern section. The office to the southwest contains another safe. Through the courtroom, the player character can access the executive level, which contains the mayor's office complete with a safe, a [[Steamer trunk (Fallout 76)|steamer trunk]], and a terminal that allows for contacting [[MAIA]] and exit to the roof of the building. The elevator leads to a [[scorchbeast]] nest, which also gives access to the open offices accessible only from the roof. ==Notable loot== * [[All the baskets!]] - Note, on a desk in the first room on the left after exiting the second elevator. * [[Fly free]] - Note, on the second level after using the first elevator, on a desk after turning left at the fork between offices. * [[Free Watoga!]] and [[Letter to Mayor]] - Notes, on the mayor's desk. * [[Waste baskets]] - Note, on a desk near the visitor terminal, directly opposite the elevator. * Two potential [[Vault-Tec bobblehead (Fallout 76)|Vault-Tec bobbleheads]]: ** On the second floor, in the locked executive office, on a desk near the [[Master Picklock|Picklock]] level 3 safe. ** On the third floor, in the locked judge's office. * Two potential [[Fallout 76 magazines|magazines]]: ** On the upper level, in the office with the [[Watoga Municipal Center terminal entries#Complaints Archive|complaints archive terminal]], on the short wooden bookshelf under the window and near the wall safe. ** On the southwest side of the upper level, in an office accessed via the corridor with the lockers, on the metal desk with the microphone and broken terminal. ==Appearances== Watoga Municipal Center appears only in ''[[Fallout 76]]''. ==Gallery== FO76 Watoga Municipal Center new.png|Exterior sign F76 Watoga Munic 2.png|Interior FO76 All the Baskets location.png|[[All the baskets!]] FO76 Waste baskets location.png|[[Waste baskets]] ==References== {{references}} {{Navbox locations FO76}} [[Category:Watoga locations]] [[ru:Муниципальный центр Ватоги]] [[uk:Муніципальний центр Ватоги]] [[zh:瓦托加市政中心]]
